descriptionChirho: The act of God visiting in judgment; punishment, retribution, or reckoning for sin. Multilingual glosses converge on castigo/dण्ड/عِقَاب/벌/adhabu across all attestations.
An appointed position of supervision or administrative responsibility; the office, charge, or role of overseeing. Glosses include oversight, supervisión, usimamizi, وِكَالَة, 담당/직무.
The act of counting, registering, or mustering people; a census or appointed roster. Glosses include numbering, registro, गिनती, hesabu, إِحْصَاء, 목록/수효.

God's watchful care or providential attention; a positive sense of divine visitation contrasting with punitive visitation. Attested in Job 10:12 with glosses care/providencia/देखभाल/عِنَايَة/돌보심/utunzaji.
A place of confinement or guarding; custody or prison. Glosses include custody, cárcel, कारागार, السِّجْن, 감독, kifungo.
Something deposited or stored up for safekeeping; goods or wealth entrusted to someone's charge. Glosses include stored-up, tesoro, संग्रह, وَدِيعَة, 저축, mali.
